# Script reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/_docs.py from scripts/_contract.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Contract 1.0 · timeline schema `remotion-ffmpeg-skill/timeline@1`.
Every script also takes `--json`, `--dry-run`, `--overwrite` and `--timeout SECONDS`.
Exit codes: input = 2, missing_tool = 3, timeout = 4, failed = 1.

## analyze.py

Measure a source with ffmpeg-skill and write timeline.json (+ captions from a file).

- Role: analysis — measures media and writes a data file (no media)
- Writes: timeline.json
- Verifies: every number comes from ffmpeg-skill probe/scenes/silence; warnings for VFR/HDR/rotation
- ffmpeg-skill: probe, scenes, silence
- `--dry-run`: plans without writing

| Argument | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `input` | string, repeatable |  | source video (or audio) file; several are joined in order first |
| `--joined` | string |  | with several inputs: where the joined source goes (default: <first>_joined.mp4) |
| `--join-transition` | string | `none` | with several inputs: ffmpeg-skill join.py --transition (default none = straight cuts) |
| `--join-duration` | number | `0.5` | transition length in seconds (default 0.5) |
| `--output` | string |  | timeline file (default: <name>.timeline.json) |
| `--captions` | string |  | SRT, WebVTT or JSON cue list to carry into the timeline (text kept as written) |
| `--words` | string |  | word timings from a speech engine (whisper JSON with word timestamps) for the Karaoke composition; without --captions the cues are grouped from these words |
| `--chapters` | string |  | chapter list, one `TIME TITLE` per line (YouTube's format, the same file ffmpeg-skill metadata.py --chapters writes into the container), or `source` for the chapters already in the input file; titles are kept as written |
| `--pip` | string |  | a second recording (camera) for the Pip composition: picture-in-picture over the source. The offset between the two is measured from their audio with ffmpeg-skill sync.py |
| `--pip-offset` | number |  | with --pip: the camera starts this many seconds after the source (negative: before), instead of measuring it -- for a camera without usable audio |
| `--pip-max-offset` | number | `30.0` | with --pip: largest offset sync.py searches, in seconds (default 30) |
| `--beats` | boolean |  | also measure the beat grid (scenes.py --beats) |
| `--highlights` | integer |  | also rank N highlight ranges (scenes.py --highlights; audio energy) for the Highlights composition |
| `--target` | number |  | with --highlights: total length the picks add up to |
| `--no-scenes` | boolean |  | skip scene-cut detection |
| `--no-silence` | boolean |  | skip silence detection (speech = whole file) |
| `--threshold` | number |  | silence level in dBFS for silence.py (default -35) |
| `--min-silence` | number |  | shortest gap in seconds that counts as silence (default 0.6) |
| `--margin` | number |  | seconds of silence kept around speech (default 0.15) |
| `--scene-threshold` | number |  | scenes.py --threshold (default 8) |

--json result (besides `status`, `dry_run`, `output`): `commands` (list[str]), `verified` (bool), `summary` (object: duration, fps, size, scenes, silences, speech_seconds, peaks, captions, chapters, beats, tempo_bpm, highlights, clips, words), `warnings` (list[str])

--dry-run --json result (besides `status`, `dry_run`, `output`): `commands` (list[str])

## init.py

Create a Remotion project with the built-in compositions (optionally npm install).

- Role: setup — creates a project folder
- Writes: project folder
- Verifies: refuses a non-empty folder; npm install exit status
- ffmpeg-skill: —
- `--dry-run`: plans without writing

| Argument | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `directory` | string |  | new project folder (must not exist, or be empty) |
| `--install` | boolean |  | run npm install after copying |

--json result (besides `status`, `dry_run`, `output`): `commands` (list[str]), `installed` (bool), `entry` (str), `compositions` (list[str])

--dry-run --json result (besides `status`, `dry_run`, `output`): `commands` (list[str])

## still.py

Render single frames as PNG to check the look before a full render.

- Role: execution — writes a new media artifact; inputs are never modified
- Writes: PNG files
- Verifies: frames must lie inside the composition; view the PNGs
- ffmpeg-skill: _contract doctor (CJK font lookup)
- `--dry-run`: plans without writing

| Argument | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--project (required)` | string |  | Remotion project folder made by init.py |
| `--comp (required)` | string |  | composition id (Captioned, Jumpcut, PeakPulse, Titled, Highlights, BeatMontage, Karaoke, Pip, or yours) |
| `--timeline (required)` | string |  | timeline.json written by analyze.py |
| `--options` | string |  | JSON object of look-and-feel options |
| `--at` | number, repeatable |  | time in seconds (repeatable) |
| `--frame` | integer, repeatable |  | frame number (repeatable) |
| `--out-dir` | string |  | folder for the PNGs (default: next to the timeline) |
| `--aspect` | string: source / 16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1 / 4:5 / 4:3 |  | output shape (default: the source's own). 9:16 for Reels/TikTok/Shorts, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 |
| `--width` | integer |  | output width in px (default: keep the source's short side) |
| `--fit` | string: blur / contain / cover |  | how the source fills another shape: blur (default when the shape changes), contain (bars) or cover (crop) |
| `--font-file` | string |  | caption font file (.ttf/.otf/.ttc/.woff2), staged into the project |
| `--brand` | string |  | ffmpeg-skill brand.json: its colours, caption colour, font and font file set the look (an --options file still wins key by key) |
| `--no-auto-font` | boolean |  | don't stage the CJK font ffmpeg-skill finds for Japanese/Chinese/Korean captions |

--json result (besides `status`, `dry_run`, `output`): `outputs` (list[str] (PNG paths)), `frames` (list[int]), `commands` (list[str]), `verified` (bool), `frame` (object|null {width, height, fit}), `font` (str|null)

--dry-run --json result (besides `status`, `dry_run`, `output`): `outputs` (list[str]), `frames` (list[int]), `commands` (list[str])

## render.py

Render a composition from a timeline, verify it (frames, fps, size, audio) and write a contact sheet.

- Role: execution — writes a new media artifact; inputs are never modified
- Writes: video file (+ contact sheet PNG)
- Verifies: exact frame count / fps / size / audio against the timeline; non-zero exit on mismatch
- ffmpeg-skill: probe, look, overlay (--overlay; --place with --sparse), _contract doctor (CJK font lookup)
- `--dry-run`: plans without writing

| Argument | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--project (required)` | string |  | Remotion project folder made by init.py |
| `--comp (required)` | string |  | composition id (Captioned, Jumpcut, PeakPulse, Titled, Highlights, BeatMontage, Karaoke, Pip, or one you added) |
| `--timeline (required)` | string |  | timeline.json written by analyze.py |
| `--options` | string |  | JSON object of look-and-feel options (see references/timeline.md) |
| `--output` | string |  | output file (default: <source>_<comp>.mp4, .mov for prores) |
| `--codec` | string: h264 / prores | `h264` | h264 (default) or prores (ProRes 422 HQ master, .mov) |
| `--crf` | integer |  | h264 quality (Remotion default 18; lower = better) |
| `--frames` | string |  | render only this frame range, e.g. 0-89 (inclusive) |
| `--fast` | boolean |  | preview quality: half resolution, quicker encode |
| `--concurrency` | string | `100%` | parallel browser tabs: a number up to the CPU cores, or a percentage (default 100%: all cores -- about twice as fast as Remotion's own default of half the cores) |
| `--no-look` | boolean |  | skip the contact sheet |
| `--overlay` | boolean |  | draw the graphics only as a transparent ProRes 4444 layer and composite it over the untouched source with ffmpeg-skill overlay.py (Captioned / PeakPulse, source frame only); with --keep-graphics the layer is kept for an editing app (Premiere, Resolve, Final Cut) |
| `--keep-graphics` | boolean |  | with --overlay: keep the transparent graphics .mov |
| `--sparse` | boolean |  | overlay mode that draws only the frames where something shows (Captioned / Karaoke / Titled) and places each stretch at its time with ffmpeg-skill overlay.py --place: much faster on long footage with gaps between captions. Falls back to the full-length layer (and says why) when this ffmpeg-skill has no --place or the source does not start at 0 |
| `--merge-gap` | number | `2.0` | with --sparse: graphics closer than this many seconds are drawn as one stretch (default 2) |
| `--aspect` | string: source / 16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1 / 4:5 / 4:3 |  | output shape (default: the source's own). 9:16 for Reels/TikTok/Shorts, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 |
| `--width` | integer |  | output width in px (default: keep the source's short side) |
| `--fit` | string: blur / contain / cover |  | how the source fills another shape: blur (default when the shape changes), contain (bars) or cover (crop) |
| `--font-file` | string |  | caption font file (.ttf/.otf/.ttc/.woff2), staged into the project |
| `--brand` | string |  | ffmpeg-skill brand.json: its colours, caption colour, font and font file set the look (an --options file still wins key by key) |
| `--no-auto-font` | boolean |  | don't stage the CJK font ffmpeg-skill finds for Japanese/Chinese/Korean captions |

--json result (besides `status`, `dry_run`, `output`): `verified` (bool), `verification` (list[{check, status, value, expected}]), `commands` (list[str]), `look` (str|null (contact sheet PNG)), `look_error` (str|null), `summary` (str), `frame` (object|null), `font` (str|null), `mode` (full|overlay), `graphics` (str|null (kept ProRes 4444 layer)), `sparse` (null|{used, reason, stretches, drawn_frames, source_frames} (--sparse)), `kind` (null|failed), `error` (null|str (which verification rows failed))

--dry-run --json result (besides `status`, `dry_run`, `output`): `commands` (list[str]), `props` (str), `expected_frames` (int|null), `frame` (object|null), `font` (str|null), `sparse` (null|object (--sparse))

## deliver.py

Run an ffmpeg-skill delivery template (YouTube, Reels, ...) and its compliance check.

- Role: execution — writes a new media artifact; inputs are never modified
- Writes: deliverable video
- Verifies: ffmpeg-skill check.py table; non-zero exit on any FAIL row
- ffmpeg-skill: render --template, metadata (--chapters), check
- `--dry-run`: plans without writing

| Argument | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `input` | string |  | rendered video |
| `--platform` | string: youtube / youtube-shorts / shorts / reels / tiktok / x / facebook / linkedin / podcast / audiogram |  | ffmpeg-skill delivery template to run |
| `--output` | string |  | deliverable path (default: <name>_<platform>.mp4) |
| `--check-only` | boolean |  | run check.py only, write nothing |
| `--brand` | string |  | ffmpeg-skill brand.json for the template (its logo, safe margins, loudness) |
| `--logo` | string |  | logo image the template places (default: the brand file's logo) |
| `--chapters` | string |  | also write these chapters (`TIME TITLE` per line) into the deliverable with ffmpeg-skill metadata.py, plus the YouTube description block next to it (<name>_description.txt) |

--json result (besides `status`, `dry_run`, `output`): `checked` (str), `platform` (str|null), `verified` (bool), `description` (str|null (YouTube description block with the chapters, --chapters)), `checks` (list[{check, status, value, expected, ...}] (ffmpeg-skill check.py rows)), `failed` (list[str]), `warnings` (list[str]), `commands` (list[str]), `kind` (null|failed), `error` (null|str)

--dry-run --json result (besides `status`, `dry_run`, `output`): `commands` (list[str])

## pipeline.py

analyze -> render -> deliver in one call, stopping at the first failed step.

- Role: orchestration — runs other tools in order, each verified before the next
- Writes: timeline.json, render, deliverable
- Verifies: each step's own verification
- ffmpeg-skill: probe, scenes, silence, look, render --template, check
- `--dry-run`: plans without writing

| Argument | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `input` | string, repeatable |  | source video; several are joined in order (ffmpeg-skill join.py) first |
| `--project (required)` | string |  | Remotion project folder made by init.py |
| `--comp (required)` | string |  | composition id (Captioned, Jumpcut, PeakPulse, Titled, Highlights, BeatMontage, Karaoke, Pip, or yours) |
| `--captions` | string |  | SRT / WebVTT / JSON cues for the timeline |
| `--chapters` | string |  | chapters (`TIME TITLE` per line, or `source`): cards in Titled and, with --platform, chapter markers in the deliverable |
| `--options` | string |  | JSON options file passed to the composition |
| `--brand` | string |  | ffmpeg-skill brand.json: the look of the graphics and, on delivery, the logo |
| `--platform` | string: youtube / youtube-shorts / shorts / reels / tiktok / x / facebook / linkedin / podcast / audiogram |  | deliver with this ffmpeg-skill template and check it |
| `--out-dir` | string |  | where the timeline, render and deliverable go (default: next to the input) |
| `--beats` | boolean |  | measure the beat grid too |
| `--fast` | boolean |  | preview-quality render |
| `--aspect` | string: source / 16:9 / 9:16 / 1:1 / 4:5 / 4:3 |  | output shape (default: the shape the --platform template delivers, else the source's) |
| `--width` | integer |  | output width in px |
| `--fit` | string: blur / contain / cover |  | blur (default when the shape changes), contain or cover |
| `--font-file` | string |  | caption font file |

--json result (besides `status`, `dry_run`, `output`): `timeline` (str), `render` (str), `deliverable` (str|null), `look` (str|null), `verified` (bool), `warnings` (list[str]), `steps` (list[{step, status, output, command}])

--dry-run --json result (besides `status`, `dry_run`, `output`): `steps` (list[{step, status, output, command}])

## doctor.py

What this machine can do: Python, Node/npm, ffmpeg-skill, ffmpeg, a project's Remotion install.

- Role: verification — checks an artifact or the environment; writes no media
- Writes: nothing
- Verifies: reports only
- ffmpeg-skill: _contract doctor
- `--dry-run`: not applicable (reports only)

| Argument | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--project` | string |  | Remotion project folder to inspect |

--json result (besides `status`, `dry_run`, `output`): `ok` (bool), `version` (str), `checks` (list[{check, ok, value, fix}]), `ffmpeg_skill_doctor` (object|null)

## Failures

Every failure is one JSON object: `status` (failed), `error` (str), `kind` (input|missing_tool|timeout|failed), `dry_run` (bool).
